Samir: Observed an allocation surge on kv-shard-canary-3 starting ~03:12 UTC; OOMs at 03:14. Metrics: https://metrics.internal/redwood/allocs?shard=3 . Synthetic canary load shows steady mem climb, paused rolling canary. Need quick mitigations + owners. pprof indicates slab residency pressure and sticky refs from async prefetch. Heap dump: s3://redwood-infer/dev/dumps/3182468100-heap.tar.gz
Maya: Oncall here. Pausing the canary and lowering concurrency now. Samir, can you add the dump link to the ticket? :thumbsup:
Samir: Link added above. Ran `pprof --alloc_space -base=baseline.pb.gz /proc/1234` and exported a top allocation list. Early read: fragmentation + sticky KV refs (alloc_map.go:112, kv_reserve.go:78).
Alex: I'll own deep profiling. Plan: 1) run slab-scan to map residency buckets, 2) enable soft eviction on shard, 3) capture per-thread alloc stacks with ms sampling. ETA: 48h for initial findings. Assigned to Alex.
Maya: Soft-limit eviction enabled and canary concurrency reduced to 50%. Canary paused.
Jen: Ops will schedule a rolling restart tonight to flush transient residency and add a temporary guard `--kv-max-residency=100MB` to the canary config. Creating a ticket now.
Ops-Bot: Ticket created: INF-1129 "alloc-surge temporary mitigations" https://jira.internal/INF-1129 Assigned to Jen, target: 2026-03-25.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed -> rev 772 restored. Health checks passing. Monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Long-term proposals: prod heap sampling, KV refcount instrumentation, safe prefetch cancellation, and slab freelist coalescing to reduce fragmentation. Propose a playbook workshop next Tue 10:00 to convert ideas to concrete actions.
Samir: Action summary: - Alex: profiling + slab-scan report (48h) - Jen/Ops: restart + kv-max-residency guard (today) - Maya: monitor gating + canary policy (ongoing) - Samir: collect alloc traces + write leak hypothesis (24h). I'll post a consolidated follow-up in #postmortems after Alex's report. Tagging @Maya @Jen @Alex
Maya: Added INF-1129 and the profiling task to my sprint board. I'll own monitoring and alerts until we ship a permanent fix. :spiral_calendar:
Samir: This pattern resembles last month's alloc surge (see INF-0987 summary https://internal/reports/INF-0987). Possible regression from async prefetch PR#801 — Alex, can you grep the delta?
Alex: Quick grep: PR#801 altered reserve semantics in alloc_map.go; I'll include commit diffs and call stacks in the profiler report.
Jen: Ops will run nightly slab-scan for the next 3 nights and post a short digest to this thread. Adding a recurring memory-drift check to on-call duties.
Samir: Next sync in 48h at 11:00 to review Alex's findings and decide remediation timeline. If anything regresses before then, reopen this thread. :eyes:
